name: hdcommunity-toolkit
description: Huawei Cloud Community Agent toolkit: MCP tools + Skills for community blogs (author/promote), experience reports, personal growth data (my points/tasks/exchange), and public read-only data. Operator/management capabilities live in hdcommunity-mng-toolkit.

interface.shortDescription: Huawei Cloud Community toolkit — MCP tools + Skills for blogs, personal growth data, and public read-only data.
interface.longDescription: Lets coding agents read/write Huawei Cloud Community blogs, view public growth-center tasks/prizes, and access their own growth data (points, tasks, sign-in, coupon exchange) through MCP tools and guided Skills. Operator/management capabilities (review, points issue, coupons, change-request approval) live in hdcommunity-mng-toolkit.
